raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 contains a 05:00 re-delivery of the 02:00 rows, and the re-delivered rows have txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716104000 = 2026-01-18 06:01:44 UTC, matching the original row). The fix parses both timestamp formats and keeps one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
